content: Claude Code (docs.code.claude.com/en/hooks) documents 30 hook events in lifecycle order: SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, Notification, MessageDisplay, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, Stop, StopFailure, TeammateIdle, InstructionsLoaded, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, PreCompact, PostCompact, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, SessionEnd. Common fields: session_id, prompt_id, transcript_path, cwd, permission_mode, effort, hook_event_name, agent_id/agent_type (subagent context). SessionStart carries source=startup|resume|clear|compact|fork. SessionEnd carries reason=clear|resume|logout|prompt_input_exit|bypass_permissions_disabled|other. Stop carries last_assistant_message + stop_hook_active. Field names for PostToolUse output (tool_response vs tool_output) and Notification (message vs notification_type) were inconsistent across two independent doc fetches -- must be confirmed by live logging in Phase 1.
